description: Shared JSON catalog behavior implemented in the web, Android, and iOS shells. Platform locale engines remain native, while all three adapters execute tests/localization/cases.json for matching, messages, plurals, file sizes, and relative time.
note: Partial, not locked: tests/localization/cases.json is a happy-path fixture. It does NOT cover missing messages, missing or invalid plural arguments, =N exact selectors, {{ }} escaping, unmatched braces, alias matching, or the generic-catalog fallback hop, so the three interpreters can diverge on any of those without the fixture noticing. A real divergence already existed on this axis: localization.ts falls back regionalLanguageTag ?? requestedLanguageTag when no regional tag is supplied, while both shells pass the regional tag straight through — every fixture message case supplies regionalLanguageTag, so the fixture is structurally unable to see it. Extend cases.json to those error paths before claiming locked. localizedAbsoluteDate/localizedYear (the License row's dates, localization.md) are NOT in cases.json either — the platforms' date formatters differ in separators — so each adapter locks them with the same two assertions of its own: src/shared/localization/localization.test.ts, apps/ios/Tests/Localization/LocalizationTests.swift and apps/android/app/src/androidTest/java/com/futo/notes/localization/AndroidLocalizationTest.kt (Android's went in with its caller, the License row).
